topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture scope and outlines how known immune components come together to drive and resolve inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Recognition of Pathogens and Tissue Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which innate sensors detect infections and cellular injury via PAMPs, DAMPs, PRRs, and inflammasomes.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream cellular processes triggered by sentinel cells, including leukocyte migration into tissue, lymphatic drainage, and systemic risks like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation, repairing tissue, and managing chronic inflammatory states such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming topic on complement.
